Subject: Ironwood - Redwood integration technical kickoff & checklist

Hi Grace / Sergio,

Thanks for agreeing to partner on the Ironwood connector. We want to align on acceptance criteria and the technical runbook before the first sandbox workshop. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm reference architecture and data flows for embeddings + streaming inference.
- Agree on security boundaries (no customer PII persisted, KV prefix caching behavior).
- A light smoke test matrix we can run in our sandbox (latency, throughput at 2k tokens/min).
- A draft mutual action plan with milestones and owners.

I attached the draft arch diagram from our infra team (ironwood-arch-diagram-v1.pdf). Can you confirm Redwood's recommended model variant for low-latency multi-tenant testing?

Available for a 45m kickoff Tues/Wed morning PT — let me know what works.

Thanks,
Anita
Head of Integrations, SummitWorks (partnering on behalf of Ironwood Analytics)

Hi Anita — thanks for the clear list. Quick replies inline: 

- Reference architecture: the diagram looks good. We recommend using a quantized variant of our rdx-large-qlora for the initial sandbox to keep GPU footprints small. Recommended endpoint: /v1/models/rdx-large-qlora:serve.
- Security boundaries: Redwood will not persist raw inputs by default for Dedicated/Private customers; for hosted we'll apply the standard 30-day logs retention unless you request stricter policy. We can provide an exportable audit log feed to your SIEM — I'll loop in Security.
- Smoke tests: attached is a lightweight test matrix we usually start with (mvp-test-matrix.xlsx). It includes latency percentiles, token accounting, and failure-mode checks.
- Milestones: propose a 6-week MLP (sandbox signoff -> canary -> production).

Proposed kickoff: Wed 18 Nov 2026, 09:30 PT. Agenda: 1) Architecture walkthrough (20m) 2) Test matrix & data samples (10m) 3) Security/compliance checklist (10m) 4) Owners & timeline (5m)

Joining: I'll host and bring Sergio (runtime reliability) and Jonas (integration eng). Can you confirm attendees from Ironwood + Procurement contact for contracts?

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference

Anita / Grace — a few technical notes ahead of the workshop so we can use the time efficiently:

- Test harness: we'll provide a small harness that runs against a sandbox model pool. It will exercise streaming + non-streaming paths and include a synthetic prefix-caching case.
- Model variants to test: rdx-large-qlora (8-bit), rdx-medium-fn, and a smaller rdx-mini baseline for throughput comparisons. Please expect different tokenization characteristics — we'll include tokenization scripts in the repo.
- Fallback behavior: define a policy for 429 / OOMs — we recommend retry-after with an immediate fallback to the smaller variant for latency-critical routes.
- Network topology: for VPC connectors, please open outbound TCP 443 to our egress IP block (see drive link).

I attached the draft MVP test matrix with columns for scenario, expected SLA, and owner. If Ironwood has sample prompts/data you can share (sanitized), drop them into the shared folder so our harness can include them in the smoke run.

Jonas
Senior Integration Engineer, Redwood Inference

Leo — short answers and proposed runbook excerpts: 

- Caching: Redwood supports ephemeral KV cache with configurable TTL per route. For hosted setups TTLs default to 2 minutes but we can set a route-level override to 5–10 minutes for your sandbox. No long-term persistence will be enabled. Eviction is LRU across the instance pool; we can reserve additional memory for the cache during the canary.
- Canary plan: week 1 sandbox smoke, week 2 controlled canary (subset of traffic via routing policy), week 3 scale to production. Each phase has clear rollback criteria based on latency P95 > 400ms or error rate > 1.5%.
- Monitoring & alerts: we'll provide a Grafana dashboard template and a webhook for your PagerDuty.

I've consolidated these details in a short runbook and a shared drive folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/ironwood/integration-archive. Please review the runbook before the kickoff; we'll walk through it live.

Sergio Alvarez
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
